entities.summary: Milo De Angelis is an Italian language poet. He is the author of several books of poetry, as well as a volume of stories and one of essays. He has also published translations of several modern French authors and Greek classics. He was born in Milan in 1951. His first collection of poetry was entitled Somiglianze (1976).
